claims.text: The datasets used for evaluation are CSAT, 20 newsgroups, and Fisher Phase 1 corpus.
The CSAT dataset consists of US English telephone speech from call centers, with 4331 calls split into training, validation, and testing sets.
The 20 newsgroups dataset contains approximately 20,000 documents from 20 topics, used for text classification.
The Fisher Phase 1 corpus consists of 10-minute long telephone conversations, used for topic identification.
